The commands and options of `StrataCLI` at engine `319075e3f92b`, from its usage text (`StrataCLI/src/CLI/CliApplication.cpp:610`).

## Usage

- `StrataCLI call <method> [params] [connection options] [--timeout <ms>] [--save-image <file>]`
- `StrataCLI list [connection options] [--json]`
- `StrataCLI status [connection options]`
- `StrataCLI launch [--project <dir>] [--headless | --no-gpu | --window-size <w>x<h>] [--ui-scale <factor>] [--idle-timeout <s>] [--editor <path>] [--wait-timeout <ms>] [--stall-timeout <s>] [--no-wait-scan]`
- `StrataCLI mcp [connection options] [--editor <path>] [--timeout <ms>] [--idle-timeout <s>] [--stall-timeout <s>] [--toolsets <name,...> | all]`
- `StrataCLI --help | --version`

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `call` | Call an editor method and print its JSON result. params is a JSON object, '-' to read it from standard input, or @&lt;file&gt; to read it from a file. Commands that take frames answer when they finish; --timeout (default 30000 ms) bounds the wait. --save-image writes an image result ({&quot;Image&quot;: {&quot;MimeType&quot;, &quot;Data&quot;}}) to a file and prints its path instead of the data |
| `list` | List the editor's methods and their descriptions (--json: with parameter schemas) |
| `status` | Show whether an editor is reachable, and the known editor sessions |
| `launch` | Start an editor (for a project, if given) and wait until it accepts connections (at most --wait-timeout, default 60000 ms), then until the project is ready: its assets scanned and its start scene open, printing the progress to stderr, for as long as it progresses (it fails when nothing progressed for --stall-timeout seconds, default 60). --no-wait-scan returns once it accepts connections. It keeps running until 'call editor.quit', or until no client has been connected for --idle-timeout seconds. --headless runs without a window, --no-gpu also without a graphics device; --window-size opens a window of exactly that many pixels (at least 640x360) and --ui-scale draws the UI at that scale (1 is 100%) instead of the display's: with both, screenshots of the editor compare across machines |
| `mcp` | Serve the Model Context Protocol on stdin/stdout (for AI agents). Editors it starts close themselves after --idle-timeout seconds without a client (default 600, 0: never). Only the commands of --toolsets are tools (default core: about 30; all: every command); the tools strata\_describe and strata\_toolsets show and enable the others, strata\_call runs any |

## Connection options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--port <n>` | Explicit endpoint (else STRATA\_EDITOR\_PORT), authenticated with the STRATA\_EDITOR\_TOKEN environment variable (preferred) or --token &lt;t&gt; |
| `--project <dir>` | The editor that has this project open (&lt;dir&gt;/.strata/EditorSession.json) |
| `(none)` | The newest running editor session that accepts a connection |
| `--host <address>` | Host of the explicit endpoint (default 127.0.0.1; requires --port) |

## Other options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--verbose` | Log diagnostics to stderr |

## Environment

| Variable | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `STRATA_EDITOR_PORT, STRATA_EDITOR_TOKEN` | Explicit editor endpoint |
| `STRATA_EDITOR_PATH` | Editor executable for launch/mcp (default: StrataEditor next to StrataCLI) |
| `STRATA_SESSION_DIR` | Private directory of editor session files (default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\\Strata\\Sessions, \~/.local/share/Strata/Sessions or \~/Library/Application Support/Strata/Sessions) |

## Exit codes

0 success; 1 the editor answered with an error; 2 no editor reachable or the connection was lost; 3 invalid command line; 4 no answer within --timeout (the command may still be running in the editor: do not start another one); 5 --save-image could not save the image.
